fieldValues.title: The original field-by-field Protocol works, once its record exists
fieldValues.summary: The governance decision protocol's nine stages ran unchanged and built a decision record from one real decision point that matches the decision the group took the next day; but its target record had to be created with a placeholder, because the type requires a field the protocol writes at stage 6.
evidence: Nested run 2026-11-27 on a copy of the 25 November meeting: 9 stages, 9 fields, each reply accepted first time
governance/decision requires decision_statement; stage 6 (Verdict) contributes it
fieldValues.body: A record under construction is not yet a valid record. The same gap makes a computed field unwritable by anything but the model.
